truth_evidence: Affected 2021.05.30 to 2024.06.02. The vulnerability is a distrusted root CA bundled in the certificate data, not a defect in Python code.

Fix commit bd81538 '2024.07.04 (#295)' removes the GLOBALTRUST root certificate from certifi/cacert.pem; the only other change is the version string. https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/commit/bd8153872e9c6fc98f4023df9c2deaffea2fa463
The fix commit also bumps __version__ in certifi/__init__.py. That is a module-level change to a .py file and must not be reported as vulnerable code.
No vulnerable function and no entry point exist; reachability is not a meaningful question for this advisory (every TLS verification using certifi.where() uses the bundle).
